source.source_title: [Amateur film: Medicus collection: New York World's Fair, 1939-40] (Reel 1) (Part I)
source.why_this_clip: A framed still photograph of a giant panda sitting and facing the camera fills the frame; the panda itself does not move, and only the camera drifts slightly over the print. The one cut is at 10.5 s, where the shot changes from a wide view of a display board to the close view, so 11.0 to 16.0 s lies inside the close shot where the panda is largest.
